high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from Google News, specifically from the "For you" section. The headline reads: "'Highest in 19 years': Heavy rainfall in Delhi makes new September record." This headline is attributed to Hindustan Times and was published 23 hours ago. The main content of the article mentions that the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has predicted thunderstorms and moderate to heavy rains in parts of the National Capital Region. The accompanying image shows a flooded street with vehicles, including cars and a truck, partially submerged in water.
